items.source: Registers an AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer that mutates the underlying OkHttp client builder before the Anthropic clients are constructed.
items.translation: 注册一个 AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer，该接口会在构建 Anthropic 客户端之前修改底层的 OkHttp 客户端构建器。

items.source: Sets the full list of customizers to apply, replacing any customizers registered earlier on this builder.
items.translation: 设置要应用的customizers完整列表，替换在此构建器上之前注册的任何自定义器。

items.source: Spring AI integration with Anthropic's Claude models using the official Anthropic Java SDK.
items.translation: 使用官方 Anthropic Java SDK 将 Spring AI 与 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型集成。

items.source:
Creates an asynchronous Anthropic client backed by a caller-supplied dispatcher
executor and with optional HTTP client customizers.
items.translation: 创建一个由调用者提供的调度器执行器支持的异步 Anthropic 客户端，并可选地配置 HTTP 客户端自定义器。

items.source:
Creates a synchronous Anthropic client backed by a caller-supplied dispatcher
executor and with optional HTTP client customizers.
items.translation: 创建一个由调用者提供的调度器执行器支持的同步 Anthropic 客户端，并可选地配置 HTTP 客户端自定义器。
AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer 在 org.springframework.ai.anthropic 中的用途
